methods.what: Curvature increment of the boundary along a cross-cut: 0 at interior points, π at each endpoint, 2π in total; each cross-cut changes the connectivity order by 1
methods.quote: für {+jeden+} [-jeden-] innern Punkt $= 0$, für [-jeden-] [-einen-] Endpunkt aber $= \pi$

methods.what: Relation k + μ = constant for simply connected pieces, extended by addition to the whole surface (Gauss–Bonnet-type relation between boundary curvature and connectivity)
methods.quote:
Nun folgt aus für jedes einfach zusammenhängende Stück, und
folglich durch Addition für alle Stücke zusammengenommen, $k+\mu = 2[?]$,
also auch für die {+ursprüngliche+} ungetheilte[?] Fläche.

items.english: Evidently the surface T is completely determined if and only if, besides the position of its boundary, it is also fixed where, and between which of its coinciding parts, it forms (possesses) knot points.
